confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live Honolulu menus or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July demand, resort fees, and taxes vary widely. FX value 0.6955 comes from a search-result summary of the RBA 4pm rate for 2026-10-15; I did not read the RBA table directly, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other US tourist and resort markets with high lodging costs and similar restaurant pricing (for example, Waikiki-area tourism, San Diego, and Maui). No live data was used.
